in_hebrew.name: בַּלְתָשַׂר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם בַּלְתָשַׂר הוא שינוי של השם בֵּל שַׂר אֶצֶר, שפירושו 'הוֹשִׁיעַ מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל'. לפי המסורת היהודית, השם ניתן לנבו-נבו, אחד משרי המלך נבוכדנצר, שהיה אחראי על בית האוצרות שלו. השם קשור למלכות בבל והוא בעל חשיבות רבה במסורת היהודית והנוצרית כאחד.

in_greek.name: Βαλθασάρ
in_greek.meaning: Βασιλεύς Βαβυλῶνος ἐκ τῆς Θεοῦ χάριτος
in_greek.long_meaning: Ὁ Βαλθασάρ ἀπὸ τὴν Ἑβραϊκὴν ὀνομάζεται Βֵּל שַׂר אֶצֶר, ὁ Βαλθασὰρ ἦν ἕνας τῶν βασιλέων τῆς Βαβυλῶνος καὶ σημαντικός ἄνθρωπος ἐπί τοῦ βασιλέως Ναβουχοδονόσορος. Ἡ οἰκονομία τοῦ ὀνόματος συνδέεται μὲ τὴν βασιλεία τῆς Βαβυλῶνος καὶ τὴν λειτουργία τῶν μάγων καὶ ἀστρονόμων ἐν τῇ αὐλῇ τοῦ βασιλέως.

in_latin.name: Balthasar
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Balthasar derivatur ex hebraeo Bêl şar Ēţer, quod interpretatur 'Deus servus regis Babylonis'. Balthasar fuit unus de regibus Babylonis et magorum ac sapientium princeps in aula regis Nabuchodonosoris. Nomen hoc apud traditionem christianam et judaicam magnam habet significationem.

in_english.name: Balthasar
in_english.meaning: God saves the king or preserves the king
in_english.long_meaning: The name Balthasar originates from the Hebrew 'Bêl şar Ēţer', meaning 'God preserves the king'. Balthasar was one of the Magi, also known as the Three Wise Men, who visited Jesus after his birth, bearing gifts. The name holds significant spiritual meaning in Christian tradition, symbolizing wisdom, spirituality, and the acknowledgment of Jesus Christ as King. Historically, Balthasar has been associated with one of the three wise men from the East, often depicted as a man of African descent.

biblical_reference.note: One of the Magi who visited Jesus

data.cultural_impact: The name Balthasar holds a rich cultural legacy from various ancient civilizations. In the Hebrew and Greek interpretations, the name represents lord and protector, suggesting a strong sense of authority and security. In the Christian tradition, Balthasar is most famously connected to the Magi, the wise men from the East mentioned in the Gospel of Matthew. They are identified as Melchior, Caspar, and Balthasar, symbolizing the representation of various nations and cultures coming together to honor the birth of Jesus Christ.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Balthasar rooted in Christianity is multifaceted. On one hand, the name conveys the idea of a protector and ruler, which can be interpreted as a reminder of God's protective and guiding role as our Lord. The Magi and their visit to the infant savior underscore this significance, as they journeyed to the birthplace of Jesus to present their gifts and symbolize the universality of God's love. On the other hand, the name can serve as an inspiration to live up to the name's meaning and strive to become a protector and a wise ruler in our own spheres of influence. By embodying the qualities of Balthasar, individuals can make an impact on the world, sharing the light and wisdom of their faith with others.
